title: Silent simulation and acceptance specification
statement: Let $K,k$ be natural numbers, let $\iota$ be an injection from the $K$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices, and choose a tape index $\mathrm{cap}$ outside the image of $\iota$. Let $j_R$ be a work-tape index for a deterministic machine $R$ with $K$ Boolean work tapes, and choose states $\mathrm{entry},\mathrm{acc},\mathrm{rej}$ of $R$. Let $P$ be a deterministic machine with $k$ Boolean work tapes and choose a state $p_{\mathrm{exit}}$ of $P$. Suppose a tape profile $\mathrm{blk}:\mathbb Z\to\mathrm{Option}(\{0,1\})$ is nonblank exactly at integer positions $p$ satisfying $0\le p<m$. Assume that after $T_P$ steps on input $z$, $P$ is in state $p_{\mathrm{exit}}$, its tape contents are blank except for this profile on tape $\iota(j_R)$, every work-tape head is at the origin, its input head is at position $1$, and its output is empty; also assume it did not visit $p_{\mathrm{exit}}$ earlier. Suppose that for every Boolean word $s$ of length $m$, the run of $R$ from its initial configuration modified to enter $\mathrm{entry}$ and place $s$ on tape $j_R$ reaches either $\mathrm{acc}$ or $\mathrm{rej}$ within $T$ steps, with neither verdict visited earlier. Then the combined nondeterministic machine halts for every choice-bit word of length $T_P+2m+T+11$. Moreover, for every $B\ge T_P+2m+T+11$, there exists a length-$B$ choice-bit word that makes this machine halt with output exactly the one-bit word $[\mathrm{true}]$ if and only if there is a length-$m$ Boolean word $s$ for which $R$ reaches $\mathrm{acc}$ at some time, having visited neither $\mathrm{acc}$ nor $\mathrm{rej}$ at any earlier time.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathrm{cap}$ is not in the range of $\iota$
$j_R$ is a work-tape index of the $K$-tape machine $R$
$R$ is a deterministic machine with $K$ Boolean work tapes
$P$ is a deterministic machine with $k$ Boolean work tapes
$z$ is a Boolean input; $T_P,m$ are natural numbers
$\mathrm{blk}$ is nonblank exactly on integer positions $0\le p<m$
After $T_P$ steps, $P$ has the specified state, input-head position, tape contents, work-head positions, and empty output
For every Boolean word of length $m$, the corresponding $R$ run reaches acceptance or rejection within some time at most $T$
Before that verdict time, the $R$ run has visited neither verdict state
$B$ is any natural number at least $T_P+2m+T+11$
